minor.issue: Returned 500 due to raw MongoDB docs (with ObjectId _id) being embedded as the 'esg' value in the joined response — FastAPI/JSON encoder blew up with `'ObjectId' object is not iterable`. Fixed by passing all sub-lookup dicts through BaseDocument.out() before use.

ui_bugs.issue: Default active tab is 'registrations' not 'analytics' (Dashboard) — spec required Dashboard as the DEFAULT active tab with KPI cards visible. On sign-in the REGISTRATIONS tab renders instead. Line 477: `const [tab, setTab] = useState('registrations');` — should be `useState('analytics')`.

action_items: Frontend: change AdminDashboard.jsx default tab state from 'registrations' to 'analytics' so 'Dashboard' is the default active tab as spec'd (KPIs visible on login).
critical_code_review_comments: vendor_intel.py /summary was returning raw Mongo docs as nested values → 500. Fixed (via _out() wrapping). Recommend a shared normalisation helper for any endpoint that builds joined responses.
analytics.py /dashboard iterates all payment_transactions with status='paid' in Python; will not scale — replace with Mongo `$group $sum` aggregation on amount for large volumes.

analytics.py /ai/bid-anomaly stores result via update_one upsert with bid_id key but never clears it — old anomalies for a bid are overwritten silently, no history. Consider `bid_anomalies` collection with append + created_at ordering if audit trail needed.

governance.py /auctions/bid does NOT re-validate `status='live'` vs the auction's start_at/end_at wall-clock — an auction with `status='scheduled'` still accepts bids because both 'scheduled' and 'live' are allowed. Should refuse bids before start_at or after end_at.

governance.py /auctions/bid uses `price >= cur - min_decrement` — this is correctly requiring strictly less-than-current-minus-decrement, but the error message says 'Must beat current price by at least minimum_decrement' — fine.
boqs.py /boq/submissions: If a vendor submits the same (template_id, bid_id) twice it will insert a second doc silently — no unique upsert. Add index/upsert.
boqs.py /contracts POST checks bid.status == 'awarded' but does not lock the contract to prevent creating a SECOND contract for the same awarded bid. Add uniqueness on bid_id in contracts.
notify.py send_email is fire-and-forget with `asyncio.create_task(...)` — if Resend is misconfigured we lose the failure silently; log the exception in a done_callback or use a background queue.

evaluations.py /rubric performs an in-place model_dump update on rubrics — does not validate that sum of technical criteria weights == 1.0. Currently `pct = total / weight_sum` normalises for any weight_sum, so it works, but users may still find surprising results when weights don't add to 1.
notifications.py list endpoint returns up to 50 latest — no pagination. NotificationBell polls every 20s; if a role gets a burst, older ones will disappear from the list forever.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all tabs render and are clickable, NotificationBell renders as 'ALERTS' — 1 default-tab bug)

rca of the issue: GET /api/v1/vendor-intel/summary → 500. Root cause: the joined response builder in routers/vendor_intel.py:88-91 constructed lookup dicts via async comprehensions storing the RAW mongo docs (which still contain `_id: ObjectId(...)`), then set `esg.get(ref, {})` as a nested value in the API response. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize `ObjectId` → TypeError('ObjectId' object is not iterable) → 500. Reproduction: after any POST to /vendor-intel/esg, GET /vendor-intel/summary. Fix applied: wrap all four lookup dicts (`ratings`, `blacklist`, `watchlist`, `esg`) with `_out()` so `_id` is converted to `id: str` before nesting. Similar issue could exist in any other endpoint that inlines raw Mongo docs — recommend a lint rule or shared serializer.
